utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard a few folks are planning to drop things off for the repair drive soon. I’ll let you know if I hear anything more specific.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So that’s still just a rumor, then? Let me know when you’ve got a date or details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, still just chatter for now—I haven’t got a date yet. I’ll tell you as soon as someone pins down the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. I’ll try to keep up with any updates too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep folks in the loop and repeat the plan as it comes together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Anytime after 2 works for me — just swing by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll come by after 2.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still figuring out the repair drive, but I’d like to help. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I need a few basics for the repair drive: tape, spare screws, and any working wire you can find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can look for tape and spare screws right away. If I find any working wire, I’ll bring that too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Faye—thank you. I’m thinking we start with the school lot on Saturday morning, then split folks by task so we can get through the repairs quickly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work if we start after drop-off and finish before lunch. I can help organize who does what around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs fixing first, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’d start with the biggest stuff first, like the broken door and the leaky faucet, and then we can handle the smaller fixes after. I’m thinking we can get going this weekend if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. Let’s start with the door and faucet this weekend, and I’d like to know the order before we begin.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together a little repair drive and would love for you to come by. If you’re free, I’ll send the details over right now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds helpful, but I’d need the details first so I can see if I can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details over right now. It’s this Saturday from 2 to 5 at my place, and we’ll be fixing up small household items with snacks on hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the details yet—what’s the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s our neighborhood repair drive—folks can bring small fix-it needs like loose hinges, leaky faucets, or squeaky doors, and we’ll help line up volunteers and tools. I’m keeping it simple and friendly so everyone can get a little help before bigger problems grow.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really helpful—thanks for filling me in. I’ll spread the word to folks I hear from.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I’ll share the repair drive details first, then we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — please go ahead and share the details, and I’ll double-check everything before I act.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Totally fair — I can keep it quiet and still help out. Just tell me what you need and I’ll swing by late if that works.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Late works. Could you just help sort the donations and leave the rest to me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What tools are you bringing, and when can you come by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill, hammer, and a spare wrench set, and I can swing by around 4 this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where things are dropped off and picked up for the repair drive. Just tell me the location and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — let's use my porch at 14 Maple if that works. I’ll leave the box there for drop-offs and pickups.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ve got your porch at 14 Maple noted for both drop-offs and pickups.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with that repair drive. What tools or supplies do you need?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I just need a wrench set, some duct tape, and a ladder if you’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got a wrench set and duct tape you can borrow, and I can bring over the ladder too. I’ll drop them by in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, can you confirm the timing and where we should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — let’s keep it simple and make sure the drop-off spot and time window are clearly set before anyone heads over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect a few folks who might want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Jules — thank you. Let me know who you connect, and I’ll make sure they have all the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to a couple of neighbors I know and pass along your details. I’ll let you know who I connect as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive. Let me know what you still need, and I’ll check what we have.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running a bit late as usual, but I’ll swing by and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush, Dane — I’ll keep a list and set aside whatever we’ve got. Just let me know when you’re on your way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been getting a lot of attention around the block — folks are pitching in little by little. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Tess — thank you. Please let me know if you hear anything about when the repair drive might start.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear a start date.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’m gathering a quick list now. If you’ve noticed anything on the block that needs fixing, send it my way and I’ll add it in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll keep an eye out and send you anything I spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — can you help sort donations and label the boxes when you get here?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can do that when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If Nell has any details to share, I can pass them along to the neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I only heard it’s for neighborhood repairs, so I’ll share that and send any more details if I get them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll let everyone know it’s for neighborhood repairs and keep an ear out for more details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked anything on the repair drive yet, but I can keep an eye on where it goes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal — that’d help a lot. Let’s keep it simple: if you see it move, just let me know where it goes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll let you know right away if I see it move and where it ends up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, is the repair drive still on for this weekend? I can bring a ladder if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for checking, Mina — I haven’t confirmed the repair drive yet. I’ll double-check the details and let you know if the ladder would help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana. Just let me know when you confirm, and I’ll be ready if you need the ladder.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can check while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be great, Ira. Thank you—I really appreciate you checking while you’re out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll see what I can find and let you know when I’m back.
